_about: Question styles per topic. 'figure' says how often a question on this topic carries a figure (always, often = about 2 in 3, sometimes = about 1 in 3, never). The blueprint picks a style from figure_styles when the question needs a figure and from text_styles otherwise. 'tips' are extra notes for the question writer. 'class_overrides' maps a class number (as a string) to any of figure, figure_styles, text_styles and tips; these replace the base values for papers of that class.
